entities.summary: Nganlam Takdra Lukhong, also known as Nganlam Tara Lukhong, Nganlam Lukhong or Lon Takdra, was a famous general of the Tibetan Empire who served as Lönchen during Trisong Detsen's reign. In many Chinese records, his name is given as Mǎ Chóngyīng.
